triggers: a kernel on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942) risks the '10. Re-Sorting Stage2 When v2 Can Reuse Routing Output' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942): 10. Re-Sorting Stage2 When v2 Can Reuse Routing Output

problem.statement: Pitfalls: FlyDSL FP8 PTPC Fused MoE on MI308X -- 10. Re-Sorting Stage2 When v2 Can Reuse Routing Output

payload.attempted: Treat the archived stage1 and stage2 kernels as independent isolated kernels and add a separate stage2 sort before the second GEMM.
payload.lesson: Preserve the integrated routing topology when migrating the full pipeline. Isolated stage harnesses are useful for task66 but are not proof of atrex-open v2 full-pipeline parity.

established_fact.mechanism: The integrated v2 path is a full fused_moe pipeline. It relies on the AITER opus sorting result and reuses the routing metadata across the two FlyDSL stages.

payload.observed: Routing cost increases and the full pipeline no longer matches the atrex-open v2 trace, even if isolated GEMM timings look reasonable.
payload.root_cause: The integrated v2 path is a full fused_moe pipeline. It relies on the AITER opus sorting result and reuses the routing metadata across the two FlyDSL stages.
